title: I’m making a competitive board game/RPG almost entirely with A
author: RaFiTaReal
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m developing a game called **D.A.D. — Dice, Adventure and Destiny**, made in **Godot** and created almost entirely with the help of AI.

The idea is to mix a **board game**, **RPG**, **card game**, and competitive gameplay. I’m still testing the concept, so the current version is more of a **demo/alpha**, with around **2 months of development** so far.

Right now, the game supports **2 to 4 players**, but the ideal/future goal is to make it work best with **3 to 6 players**. Each player chooses a champion, uses and builds their deck, levels up to **level 11**, fights creatures, bosses, and other players, and can also cooperate in some situations.

The main goal is to reach **35 rounds**, and whoever has the most **Prestige** wins. There is also another way to win: defeating the **Final Boss**.

The combat system is based on **dice rolls + bonuses + cards**. You roll dice to attack, use cards to boost your plays, improve defense, deal more damage, create combos, and change the outcome of battles. The game also has PvP, co-op, common creatures, regional bosses, and different choices across the map.

This is still an idea in testing, so I’m posting here mostly to exchange feedback with other devs who also use AI in their workflow. I’d love to know if the concept sounds fun, what could be improved, and whether this mix of board game + RPG + cards works well.

I made an [itch.io](http://itch.io) page for anyone who wants to try it:  
[https://rafitareal.itch.io/dad-dados-aventura-e-destino](https://rafitareal.itch.io/dad-dados-aventura-e-destino)

I’ll also include some screenshots of the game in the post. Any feedback about gameplay, visuals, the core idea, or the use of AI in development is very welcome!
